product.name: Customized Storage Spaces
product.description: Provides storage units tailored to client needs with flexible sizing and contract terms for personal or commercial use.

product.name: Delivery Services
product.description: Offers transportation of goods to and from warehouses using a fleet of over 50 vehicles of various sizes.

product.name: Goods Handling Services
product.description: Includes receiving, sorting, and managing inventory to support storage and logistics operations.

product.name: Logistics Management Platform
product.description: A digital platform that enables clients to manage, monitor, and adjust their inventory and logistics operations through a user-friendly interface.

product.name: Customs Clearance Services
product.description: Manages import and export customs procedures in Saudi Arabia, including documentation, compliance, and regulatory support.

product.name: Sorting Solutions
product.description: Offers tailored sorting and organization of goods to prepare inventory for storage or distribution.
